description: Source code defining the Node class and related utilities for decision tree nodes in Spark MLlib.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a decision tree, including methods for prediction, copying, and traversal.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts the value for given features based on the node's split or prediction.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the subtree rooted at this node.

methods.name: numDescendants
methods.description: Returns the number of descendant nodes.

methods.name: subtreeDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the subtree from this node.

methods.name: subtreeToString
methods.description: Recursively generates a string representation of the subtree.

methods.name: subtreeIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing the subtree in DFS order.
